capabilities: Generate quiz questions from a note
Save scores and attempt history in Markdown
Import generated quiz Markdown from the clipboard
extras: AI generation is optional and goes through Claudian; with other tools such as Copilot, Codex, OpenCode or Ollama the prompt is copied out and the result pasted back. Install from the GitHub Releases ZIP, not the source code.
problem: Notes are read but never tested, and Obsidian has no built-in way to practice recall or keep a record of quiz attempts.

relations.evidence: Generate quiz sends the current note and the configured prompt to Claudian.

summary: Turns notes into multiple-choice and text quizzes, grades answers, and saves scores and attempt history in Markdown.
